title: Urethral swab for men
what: This is a swab from the urethra, the tube urine comes out of. It looks for inflammation and sexually transmitted infections.
why: For burning and discharge, pain when peeing, after unprotected sex, and when a couple is planning a pregnancy.
duration: the swab takes about a minute; results usually come in 1 to 5 days
tell_doctor: What symptoms you have, and for how many days
If you took antibiotics in the past few weeks
If you had unprotected sex, and when
If your partner was found to have an infection

prepare.title: Peeing
prepare.text: Usually do not pee for 2 to 3 hours before the swab. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Sex
prepare.text: Usually no sex for 1 to 2 days before the test.

prepare.title: Antibiotics
prepare.text: It is better to do the test before starting antibiotics. If you already take them, do not stop on your own. Tell your doctor.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: Shower the evening before. In the morning, do not use antiseptics or intimate gels.

steps: You stand or lie on the exam table
The head of the penis is wiped with a wipe
A thin probe is put a short way into the urethra
The probe is turned for a few seconds and taken out
The sample is put in a tube or on a glass slide
feel: It is unpleasant and may burn for a few seconds
The first time you pee after the test, it may sting a little
after: Drink water as usual. The burning goes away within a day
Better to avoid sex until the result comes
If an infection is found, both partners usually need treatment
red_flags: You cannot pee, or have severe pain in the lower belly: call emergency services
High fever, or pain and swelling in the scrotum: see a doctor the same day
Blood in your urine for more than a day: see a doctor

faq.a: Mostly it is unpleasant and stings for a few seconds. There is usually no strong pain.

faq.q: Can I give urine instead of a swab?
faq.a: For many PCR tests, the first part of your urine stream works too. Your doctor will say what is best for you.

reminders.text: Urethral swab soon. Do not pee before the test, and do not use antiseptics.
